crossRefs.note: When they had appointed him a day, many people came to him at his lodging. He explained to them, testifying about God’s…
whenever I travel to Spain, I will come to you. For I hope to see you on my journey, and to be helped on my way there…
Having this confidence, I know that I will remain, yes, and remain with you all for your progress and joy in the faith,
that your rejoicing may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.
But I trust in the Lord that I myself also will come shortly.
Know that our brother Timothy has been freed, with whom, if he comes shortly, I will see you.
Having many things to write to you, I don’t want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you, and to speak…

translations.web: Also, prepare a guest room for me, for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.
translations.bsb: In the meantime, prepare a guest room for me, because I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.
translations.kjv: But withal prepare me also a lodging: for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given unto you.
translations.asv: But withal prepare me also a lodging: for I hope that through your prayers I shall be granted unto you.
